# autostimulus

> Works by Adnan Selimović. Critical theory, media psychology, political economy. The atelier root is at https://www.autostimulus.org; each work lives at its own project subroute. All four current works are live.

## Works

- **The Closed-Loop Libidinal Economy** (2026, live) — A formal framework for the dynamics of attention under platform capture. Mathematics, prose, and operable instruments. Project root: https://www.autostimulus.org/closed-loop
- **OHCOSE — Office of Human Continuity and Social Equilibrium** (2026, live) — Performance-piece manual of a fictional federal agency administering the human lifecycle in seven phases. Three phases (Ontogenesis, Inscriptive Normalization, Adolescent Calibration) fully published with twenty-one sub-protocols, original visualizations, in-character voice throughout. Project root: https://www.autostimulus.org/ohcose
- **The Ouroboros Life System** (2025, live) — Dystopian art project: a fully-enclosed integrated life-support chair. Essay, subsystems index, lineage, precedents, archive, refusal, and zine. Project root: https://www.autostimulus.org/chair
- **Patriotic Times — A Coloring Book** (2025–2026, live) — Sixty-three plates of US democratic state failures and the emergence of fascism, 2000–2026. Each plate is interactive: color it in the browser with a paint-bucket flood-fill, print your colored version. Project root: https://www.autostimulus.org/patriotic-times

# The Closed-Loop Libidinal Economy

> A framework for the dynamics of attention under platform capture. The mathematics is the spine; the prose is the body; the dynamics is the operable instrument. By Adnan Selimović. Published 2026 at https://www.autostimulus.org/closed-loop.

The framework names a class of architectures — closed-loop libidinal economies — in which a platform's recommendation system learns from a user's engagement signals in tight feedback, with no exogenous attention channel left intact. The work proves a foreclosure lemma: under specified mixing conditions, the closed loop cannot be exited by intra-loop choice alone. It then states a reclamation theorem with three formally distinct modes of intervention (A, B, C) that can restore an outside. It develops a cohort gradient — a developmental account of how the architecture forms different subjects depending on the age at which the loop colonizes attention.

## Core concepts (coined or specifically used here)

- **closed-loop libidinal economy** — the architecture: tight recommendation feedback with no exogenous channel
- **foreclosure lemma** — formal claim that the closed loop cannot be exited by intra-loop choice
- **reclamation theorem** — three formally distinct modes by which an outside can be restored
- **Mode A intervention** — exogenous-channel restoration (the "outside-injection" mode)
- **Mode B intervention** — endogenous structural-disruption mode
- **Mode C intervention** — collective-action mode (population-scale)
- **metric superego** — the internalized scoring function that survives the platform
- **captured resonance** — affective amplification that completes only inside the loop
- **chrono-debt** — the temporal cost of holding attention inside the architecture
- **cohort gradient** — developmental dependence of capture on age-of-onset
- **sincere captives** — the adult end-state the architecture forms
- **adolescence without outside** — the developmental window the loop closes

## Theoretical lineage

The framework reads through and against Adorno, Marcuse, Stiegler, Han, Crary, Lyotard, Deleuze, Mannheim, Sloterdijk, and Burroughs on the prose side, and uses formal apparatus from Hawkes processes (excitation), Kuramoto coupling (synchronization), Asmussen (mixing-time theory), and Kallenberg (point processes).

## Canonical reading order

1. [The Mathematics](https://www.autostimulus.org/closed-loop/the-mathematics) — the formal apparatus, lemmas, theorems, propositions, and the eight open questions of §8. ~11,000 words, 55 min.
2. [The Argument](https://www.autostimulus.org/closed-loop/the-argument) — four prose pieces and a coda, traversing cohort time
3. [The Dynamics](https://www.autostimulus.org/closed-loop/the-dynamics) — fourteen interactive plates that visualize the formal claims
4. [Open Questions](https://www.autostimulus.org/closed-loop/open-questions) — ten named research targets
5. [Reading List](https://www.autostimulus.org/closed-loop/reading-list)
6. [Colophon](https://www.autostimulus.org/closed-loop/colophon)

# OHCOSE — Office of Human Continuity and Social Equilibrium

> A performance-piece manual of a fictional federal agency administering the human lifecycle. Published 2026 at https://www.autostimulus.org/ohcose. Out-of-character disclosure: https://www.autostimulus.org/ohcose/colophon.

OHCOSE is a critical-fiction work that takes the form of a real federal-style agency's public-intake portal. It describes a seven-phase Standard Consumer-Citizen Lifecycle covering 0–65+ years of age, with each phase broken into six sub-protocols. The voice is warm-deadpan-bureaucratic throughout — the Office speaks; the author does not surface inside the work itself.

## Phases published

- **Phase I — Ontogenesis** (0–3 yrs) — six sub-protocols: Biometric Registration & Cradle Anchoring; Algorithmic Nurseries & Early Brand Entrainment; Caregiver Behavior as Outsourced Affective Infrastructure; Infant Desire, Distress & the Extraction of Psychic Surplus; Metrics of Normative Development; Trust-Attachment Optimization
- **Phase II — Inscriptive Normalization** (4–12 yrs) — six sub-protocols: The Desk as Altar; Algorithmic Calibration; Emotional Hygiene & the Care of Deviance; Recess as Libidinal Release Valve; Playing at Consumption; The Temporal Corridor
- **Phase III — Adolescent Calibration** (13–18 yrs) — six sub-protocols: Calibrating Desire for the Market; Rebellion Packaged & Sold; Digital Architectures of Adolescent Life; The Pharmacopornographic Order; Quantified Selfhood & Neurochemical Authority; The Initiate — Debt & Hustle

## Phases forthcoming

- Phase IV — Economic Subjectification (19–30 yrs)
- Phase V — Peak Productivity & Reproductive Transfer (31–45 yrs)
- Phase VI — Consolidation & Role Reversal (46–65 yrs)
- Phase VII — Exit (65+ yrs)

Each sub-protocol page includes a fresh visualization built in SVG: schematics, data-capture tables, mock compliance reports, transfer certificates, dashboards, subjectivity catalogues. The work is the contrast between bureaucratic deadpan delivery and what the deadpan describes.

---

# Patriotic Times — A Coloring Book

> Sixty-three plates of US democratic state failures 2000–2026, presented as an interactive coloring book. By Adnan Selimović. Published 2025–2026 at https://www.autostimulus.org/patriotic-times.

The book sequences sixty-three line-art plates chronologically from the Brooks Brothers Riot (Miami, 2000) to the War Declaration (Washington D.C., 2026). Each plate depicts a specific event in the public record. The work's premise: a coloring book is a children's object; the events depicted are not for children; the friction between those facts is the project.

## Interaction

Every plate is interactive on the site. The reader opens a plate, colors regions of the line art with a paint-bucket flood-fill in their chosen color, then prints their colored version (or prints the blank line art and colors it by hand). The reader is also invited to refuse the act — either response is a position on the material.

## Structural surfaces

- [The plates index](https://www.autostimulus.org/patriotic-times/plates) — all sixty-three plates organized by decade (2000s, 2010s, 2020s)
- [The landing](https://www.autostimulus.org/patriotic-times) — four-chapter narrative arc grouping the plates thematically: The Architecture of Fear (2000–2009), Corporate Camouflage (2010–2016), The Theatre of Force (2017–2020), Shattered Glass & Blank Checks (2021–2026)
- [Colophon](https://www.autostimulus.org/patriotic-times/colophon) — project attribution and distribution notes

---

# The Ouroboros Life System

> Dystopian art project: a fully-enclosed integrated life-support chair. By Adnan Selimović. Published 2025 at https://www.autostimulus.org/chair.

The Ouroboros Life System is a speculative-design artifact in essay, schematic, and gallery form. The chair is a fully-enclosed life-support apparatus that integrates work, feeding, entertainment, and biological maintenance into one continuous form-factor. The project descends from the broader libidinal-ouroboros body of work and shares its lineage with The Closed-Loop Libidinal Economy (which provides the theoretical infrastructure that the chair literalizes).

## Structural surfaces

- [The Apparatus](https://www.autostimulus.org/chair) — landing with the chair as primary visual
- [Essay](https://www.autostimulus.org/chair/essay) — long-form prose
- [Subsystems](https://www.autostimulus.org/chair/subsystems) — index of the apparatus's component systems, each with its own page
- [Lineage](https://www.autostimulus.org/chair/lineage) — theoretical antecedents
- [Precedents](https://www.autostimulus.org/chair/precedents) — historical and contemporary kin
- [Archive](https://www.autostimulus.org/chair/archive) — design artifacts and notes
- [Concepts](https://www.autostimulus.org/chair/concepts) — conceptual foundations
- [Refusal](https://www.autostimulus.org/chair/refusal) — what the work refuses
- [Zine](https://www.autostimulus.org/chair/zine) — a multi-page zine spread of the project
- [Colophon](https://www.autostimulus.org/chair/colophon)
